response.sql: WITH race_name_averages AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points FROM races AS r JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_points) AS average_points FROM race_name_averages) SELECT a.race_name, a.average_points, a.average_points - o.average_points AS difference FROM race_name_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE a.average_points > o.average_points
